question: Should the draft new/compute/alibaba-cloud-agent-sandbox-acs.json (Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox / ACS) be admitted as its own record instead of being rejected as a duplicate of compute/alibaba-agentbay?
why: AgentBay is an execution platform with Browser Use, Computer Use, Code Space and Mobile Use on Basic/Pro/Ultra plans; Agent Sandbox is a public-preview E2B-compatible microVM sandbox billed per vCPU-second with a 30 GiB active-storage allowance. They are distinct first-party products, so the draft's paid-only verdict and email identity do not apply to AgentBay, whose qualifies-with-caveat verdict and card identity are confirmed from its own pages.
